31792-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy articles such as primary, secondary, vocational and higher education, studiefinanciering, culture and childcare. It takes effect from 1 December 2008 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science for 2008 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2008 wordt gewijzigd

32018-(R1885).s: The bill sets out the organisation, management and cooperation of the public prosecution services (openbare ministeries) of Curaçao, Sint Maarten and Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, under a joint procureur-generaal. It also regulates appointment, dismissal, budgeting, ministerial instructions to prosecutors (including binding review by the Gemeenschappelijk Hof for specific instructions) and judicial review of employment decisions.
32018-(R1885).j: The memorandum justifies the instruction powers as needed so ministers can account to their parliaments for criminal law enforcement, and limits them with prior judicial review of specific instructions.
q: Article 13 of this bill gives the Ministers of Justice the power to give the procureur-generaal general and specific instructions on investigation and prosecution in their country.

Artikel 13 van dit voorstel kent aan de ministers van Justitie de bevoegdheid toe de procureur-generaal algemene en bijzondere aanwijzingen te geven met betrekking tot de opsporing en vervolging in hun land.
d: general instructions to procureur-generaal on prosecution
designation of universities and equivalent degrees for prosecutors
legal position of prosecution members, suspension and dismissal rules
allocation key for costs of the joint parquet
appointment procedure rules for prosecution members in first instance
other tasks assigned to the procureur-generaal by landsverordening or wet
p: Ministers of Justitie may give general and written, reasoned instructions to the procureur-generaal on investigation and prosecution.
Specific instructions require prior judicial review by the Hof on legality before they can be given, which limits ministerial discretion.
The procureur-generaal may issue general and specific instructions to all prosecution members on exercising their powers.
Ministers may depart from the joint recommendation for appointing the procureur-generaal after consulting the Hof and procureur-generaal, with reasons given.
Dismissal for proven unsuitability (other than illness) is possible, with a hearing before a decision and a ministerial proposal to the Council of Ministers.
Prosecution members and interested parties may appeal employment decisions to the Gerecht and Hof.

parties: Welcomes removal of the minister's directive power and its replacement by court review, but asks how far the PG's democratic accountability reaches across three countries.
Questions the effectiveness given serious crime problems, and asks why the minister's directive power was dropped given earlier agreement and the Raad van State's advice.
Why was the directive power included in the original bill when the legal objections, its very limited scope and its tie to very specific circumstances could have been known?

Op grond waarvan is er in het aanvankelijke wetsvoorstel toch voor gekozen de aanwijzingsbevoegdheid wel op te nemen, terwijl de juridische bezwaren, de zeer beperkte reikwijdte en gebondenheid van deze bevoegdheid aan zeer specifieke omstandigheden bekend hadden kunnen zijn?
Asks about the PG's directive and override powers, the independence of prosecutors across the parquets, and capacity to tackle corruption.
Does the PG, for example, also have directive authority or override power to give instructions in concrete cases or a casting vote?
Heeft deze bijvoorbeeld ook aanwijzingsbevoegdheid of doorzettingsmacht om in concrete gevallen aanwijzingen te geven of een beslissende stem te hebben?
Asks about the differing treatment of the courts and prosecution, cost and staffing implications, and the absence of a confidentiality duty for prosecutors.
The PvdA members miss a confidentiality obligation for judicial officials in this bill.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie missen de geheimhoudingsplicht voor rechterlijke ambtenaren in dit wetsvoorstel.
Supports protecting citizens from integrity violations and corruption by officials, and asks whether the court can compel the PG to prosecute such conduct.
The D66 members ask whether they may read article 12 as intending that the Court can compel the PG to prosecute integrity violations and corrupt conduct by officials.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of zij artikel 12 van de voorliggende Rijkswet zo mogen uitleggen dat het mede de bedoeling heeft dat het Hof de PG kan verplichten integriteitschendingen en corrupt handelen door bestuurders te (doen) vervolgen.
Questions whether a single joint PG can be locally rooted, and whether the minister and PG positions create a conflict for local heads of prosecution.

These members ask the government to respond to the claim that by choosing a single joint PG, social and cultural differences on the individual islands may not be adequately reflected in locally embedded prosecution.

Deze leden vragen de regering in dit kader te reageren op de stelling dat door te kiezen voor één gezamenlijke procureur-generaal de sociale, culturele of sociaal-culturele verschillen op de afzonderlijke (ei)landen onvoldoende tot uiting kunnen komen.

Objects to the courts' power to order the procureur-generaal to prosecute and provide information, arguing it undermines the prosecutor's independence, and objects to the absence of a termination clause.
According to the MAN fractie, the independent position of the Caribbean procureur-generaal is further undermined by the provisions of article 12 of the present bill.
Volgens de MAN-fractie wordt de zelfstandige positie van de Caraïbische procureur-generaal verder ondermijnd door het gestelde in artikel 12 van het onderhavige voorstel van rijkswet.

v.summary: The Raad van State van het Koninkrijk advised on the draft Rijkswet on the organisation of the public prosecution services of Curaçao, Sint Maarten and the BES islands, objecting to the Minister of Justice's proposed instruction power over the Procureur-Generaal and advising a more restrictive, legally secured design. The government's nader rapport reports that the instruction power as a Rijksministerraad competence was dropped and replaced by a court-review mechanism and mandatory ministerial consultation, largely following the advice.
concerns: The Raad objected that the Minister's instruction power over the Procureur-Generaal could seriously undermine the independence of the public prosecution service and invite political influence, and the government removed the Rijksministerraad instruction power.

The Raad questioned the necessity of the instruction power given existing supervisory mechanisms and the lack of justification for a separate special instruction power, and the government replaced it with alternative safeguards.

The Raad held that the Statute's Article 43 guarantee function must be explicitly and precisely embedded in the statutory conditions for any instruction power, and the government adjusted the regime while relying on Article 43 and 51 as backstop.
The Raad found that the 60-day decision term was not a mere guideline term and that legal consequences of non-decision must be regulated, and the instruction-power mechanism was reworked accordingly.

The Raad advised procedural safeguards for the court review of instructions, including suspensive effect and applicable procedural law, which the government addressed by changing the review structure.
The Raad advised clarifying the wording on acting for the Rijksministerraad and on the liability of the Staat der Nederlanden rather than the Koninkrijk, and the text was amended.

32395-VIII.s: This is the first supplementary budget amendment (wijziging van de begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science for 2010, adjusting appropriations and receipts across primary, secondary, vocational, higher and university education, culture, media, research and childcare. It sets the amended budget statement in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 1 June 2010 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: A portion of the spending for the 2010 OV annual travel card was already paid in 2009.
Een gedeelte van de uitgaven voor de OV-jaarkaart 2010 is reeds in 2009 voldaan.

32609-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation and the budgets of its service agencies through an incidental supplementary budget linked to departmental reorganisation. It also exempts the Economic Structure Enhancement Fund from preparing an annual report and closing balance for 2011.
32609-XIII.j: The memorandum justifies the exemption by explaining that the Fund's accountability for 2011 will not rest on financial annual statements, so the usual Comptabiliteitswet requirement is set aside for that year.
q: Notwithstanding Article 51(2) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, for the Economic Structure Enhancement Fund budget for 2011 the responsible Minister will prepare no annual report and no closing balance.

In afwijking van artikel 51, tweede lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 wordt met betrekking tot de begroting van het Fonds Economische Structuurversterking over het jaar 2011 door Onze betrokken Minister geen jaarverslag en geen saldibalans opgemaakt.

32780-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation, including supplementary budget items and operating-statement changes for inspection services that merge into the new Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (nVWA). It is a budgetary adjustment formalising reallocations via the Spring Memorandum and sets the entry-into-force date.
32780-XIII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes as formalising a horizontal cash-flow shift needed to cover previously identified shortfalls in nature and landscape management.
q: The coverage took place through a horizontal cash shift from 2011 and is formalised in this bill.
De dekking heeft plaatsgevonden via een horizontale kasverschuiving vanuit 2011 en wordt geformaliseerd bij het onderhavige wetsvoorstel.

33280-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (article 1), setting figures in thousands of euros and taking effect from 1 June 2012, with retroactive effect if published later. It records supplementary budget changes linked to the Spring Memorandum, including care spending and the Budgettair Kader Zorg framework.
q: This act takes effect as of 1 June of the current budget year.
Deze wet treedt in werking met ingang van 1 juni van het onderhavige begrotingsjaar.

33640-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport by reallocating spending and receipts across policy and non-policy articles, as set out in the attached annex. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force of the amendment as 1 June 2013.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2013 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34000-XVII.s: This bill sets the 2015 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking, article XVII), fixing expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros and specifying policy articles such as sustainable trade, development, social progress and peace and security. Its entry into force is tied to 1 January 2015 and to publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2015 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34085-XIII.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2014 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and the budget statements of its agencies, adjusting appropriations, expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2014 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34358-(R2065).s: The bill amends the Passport Act so that passports and Dutch identity cards of persons under an exit ban under the Temporary terrorism measures act lapse by operation of law, and creates a replacement identity card valid for five years that cannot be declared invalid. It also extends refusal grounds and cross-references the Dutch nationality, Moluccan, criminal code and identification-duty provisions to the new replacement card.
34358-(R2065).j: The memorandum justifies the lapse of documents by arguing that the exit ban decision already contains an integrated assessment of necessity and proportionality, and that a separate procedure would be duplicative and ineffective against jihadist travel.
q: With the legal construction whereby the travel document lapses by operation of law, the assessment of the grounds leading to lapse is placed with the authority most suited to the decision, in this case the Minister of Justice and Security.

Met de rechtsfiguur, waarbij het desbetreffende reisdocument van betrokkene van rechtswege vervalt, wordt de beoordeling van de redenen die tot het vervallen van een reisdocument leiden, gelegd bij de autoriteit die voor de desbetreffende beslissing de meest aangewezene is
d: issuance of replacement Dutch identity card within the limits of the Act
p: I, onderdelen E, F, L, N (artikelen 23b, 25, 46a0, 47)

Passports lapse by operation of law and refusal becomes mandatory on request of the Minister of Justice and Security when a person is subject to an exit ban, removing the separate paspoort-level assessment, while appeal to the administrative court remains available against the underlying exit ban.

parties: Asks whether the replacement identity card could stigmatise holders and how staff are instructed, and questions why objections against refusing a new travel document are open when the refusal follows from the exit ban itself.
After all, no objection and appeal is possible against declaring a travel document lapsed.
Er is immers ook geen bezwaar en beroep mogelijk bij het vervallen verklaren van een reisdocument.
Questions how a person can contest an exit ban when intelligence information is confidential and cannot be disclosed to the defence, and whether the rights protection is adequate.
How can the person whose passport is taken, or on appeal, make it plausible that an exit ban was wrongly imposed?
Hoe kan de betrokkene van wie het paspoort wordt afgenomen dan wel in beroep aannemelijk maken dat een uitreisverbod onterecht is opgelegd?
Finds it undesirable that the defence cannot access secret information underlying an exit ban and asks whether such information can be tested to better guarantee legal protection.
Does the government see possibilities to still have certain information tested so that suspects' legal protection can be better guaranteed?
Ziet de regering mogelijkheden bepaalde informatie toch te laten toetsen zodat de rechtsbescherming van verdachten beter gewaarborgd kan worden?

Asks what happens if an exit ban proves unjustified, whether lapsed documents revive automatically and signalings are removed, and questions the vague compensation arrangement; also asks why the amendment is permanent while the underlying act is temporary.
This comes across to these members as too non-committal.
Dat komt deze leden te vrijblijvend over.
Asks about the effect on dual nationals, European coordination on signalling potential travellers, and how the replacement card differs visually from the regular identity card.
The government states that these additional measures must be established at European level.
De regering stelt, dat deze aanvullende maatregelen op Europees niveau moeten worden vastgesteld.
Asks what added value the bill has as a standalone law given existing Passport Act article 23, and why it was not included in the temporary counter-terrorism measures act.
To what extent does this bill have added value as a standalone bill?
In hoeverre heeft dit wetsvoorstel als zelfstandig wetsvoorstel toegevoegde waarde?

Asks whether the replacement identity card could be confused with the regular card, whether it should be stated explicitly that it is not a travel document, and how lapsing is communicated to municipalities and to persons already abroad.
Does the name 'replacement identity card' not foster confusion that it concerns exactly the same document?
Werkt de naam «vervangende identiteitskaart» niet de verwarring in de hand dat het gaat om precies hetzelfde document?
Wants to be informed about the effects of the bill on citizens' fundamental rights.
would like to be informed about the consequences of this draft for citizens' fundamental rights.
wordt graag ingelicht ten aanzien van de gevolgen van dit ontwerp op de grondrechten van burgers.
Asks which measures Sint Maarten takes against jihadism and how the identity card requirement would be applied if the card is taken away, including costs of a new card type.
Which measures are being taken by Sint Maarten against jihadism.
Welke maatregelen worden door Sint Maarten genomen tegen jihadisme.
Asks how the bill will be implemented.
asks how this draft will be implemented.
vraagt hoe dit ontwerp zal worden geïmplementeerd.
Requests a clause regulating cases of wrong identity.
requests that a clause be included regulating cases of wrong identity.
verzoekt dat een clausule wordt opgenomen dat gevallen van verkeerde identiteit regelt.

v.summary: The Council of State advised proceeding with the bill amending the Passport Act so that passports and Dutch identity cards lapse by law when an exit ban is imposed, but asked for better justification of departing from the regular procedure, attention to legal protection and effectiveness, and clarification of how the replacement identity card will signal to border authorities that the holder may not leave the Schengen area. The government's nader rapport accepted these points, supplementing the explanatory memorandum on the relationship with the exit ban, the lack of a conformity procedure, and the design of the replacement card, and made a redactional change to article 17.
concerns: The Council asked the explanatory memorandum to justify departing from the regular Passport Act procedure for lapse of travel documents, which the government addressed by supplementing chapter 6.2.

The Council raised concerns about legal protection and the absence of the conformity procedure under article 44 of the Passport Act; the government argued the exit ban's own legal protection applies and clarified the explanatory memorandum.

The Council questioned whether a separate exit ban is necessary given existing article 23 of the Passport Act; the government explained the advantages of automatic lapse, including registration in the Basisregister reisdocumenten, SIS-II and Interpol systems.

The Council asked how the replacement identity card would be designed so border authorities recognise the holder may not leave the Schengen area while limiting stigmatisation; the government added an English text and visual marker.
The Council made a redactional remark on article 17, paragraph 2, asking to clarify the situations covered and whether residence other than living is included; the government adopted the change.

34960-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2018 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget of agency DUO (Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs) for 2018, with mutations in spending, commitments and receipts across education, culture and media articles. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2018, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2018 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34992-(R2106).s: The bill approves the 2008 UN Convention on the carriage of goods wholly or partly by sea (Rotterdam Rules) for the whole Kingdom and approves intended denunciation of two earlier Brussels cognossement protocols for parts of the Kingdom. It also sets the entry-into-force date and publication requirements.
q: The UN Convention on contracts for the international carriage of goods wholly or partly by sea, concluded in New York on 11 December 2008, requires approval by the States General under article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound by it.

Het op 11 december 2008 te New York tot stand gekomen Verdrag van de Verenigde Naties inzake de overeenkomsten voor het internationale vervoer van goederen geheel of gedeeltelijk over zee ingevolge artikel 91, eerste lid, van de Grondwet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal behoeft

parties: Asks the government to specify which treaty provisions are directly binding on everyone under Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution, so Parliament and courts have clear insight.
These members ask whether the government included this sentence to implement the second paragraph of Article 2 of the Treaty Approval and Publication Act.
Deze leden vragen of de regering deze zin heeft opgenomen ter uitvoering van het tweede lid van artikel 2 van de Rijkswet goedkeuring en bekendmaking verdragen.

Asks about the ratification stage of neighbouring countries and major trading partners, and notes that industry groups want Dutch ratification conditional on theirs; points to the entry-into-force by royal decree as a possible safeguard.
Article VI of the bill already provides for this possibility, since it stipulates that the act enters into force by royal decree.
Artikel VI van het wetsvoorstel voorziet reeds in deze mogelijkheid, omdat hierin is bepaald dat de inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel geschiedt bij koninklijk besluit.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering advised proceeding with the approval act for the UN Rotterdam-type convention on carriage of goods wholly or partly by sea, but asked the explanatory memorandum to explain the consequences for the Dutch logistics sector, particularly for inland transport legs covered by the convention. The government's reply adds explanation of why the convention covers ancillary non-maritime transport, how it applies, and its effects on the logistics sector.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should explain the consequences of the convention for the Dutch logistics sector, including the higher liability regime applying to ancillary non-maritime transport.
The memorandum should explain why the convention deliberately extends to sea contracts involving other transport modes.

35095-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (Tweede suppletoire begroting) and the budget statement of agency DUO, adjusting expenditure, income and commitments by article. It also sets the effective date as 1 December 2018 and the reporting unit as thousands of euros.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35350-XIV.s: This bill amends the 2019 second supplementary budget for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the agency budget of the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA), and the Animal Health Fund for 2019, shifting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force rule, with retroactive effect to 1 December 2019 if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality for 2019 is amended.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd.

35350-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statutes of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (second supplementary budget), adjusting appropriations and receipts across its articles, with changes effective from 1 December 2019. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, and the explanatory memorandum only reports underspending and cost shifts in subsidy and health programmes.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2019 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35570-XIII.s: This bill fixes the 2021 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (EZK) and the budget statements for its baten-lastenagentschappen (Agentschap Telecom, DICTU, Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit, RVO.nl) in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum sets out spending priorities and related policy, but the bill itself delegates no rule-making power and shifts no power toward the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2021 attached to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued a blanco advice (no remarks) on the 2021 budget bill for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, except that it noted one non-blank advice on the Ministry of Finance budget. The Minister of Finance, on behalf of the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, submitted a nader rapport replying to that remark in an annex and proposing some budget amendments.

35975-XII.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget statute of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (second supplementary budget) and the operating budgets of its agencies Rijkswaterstaat, ILT and KNMI, in thousands of euros, effective the day after publication. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, so the power shifts are limited to budget appropriations.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management for the year 2021.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat voor het jaar 2021.

36250-XIV.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statements for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority agency, and the Animal Health Fund, through a second supplementary budget. The memorandum explains increases for Brexit-related inspection capacity at KCB, SKAL, NVWA manure enforcement, and transfers of specific grants between departments.
36250-XIV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by citing Brexit inspection needs, new EU organic regulation, and the nitrates action programme requiring additional enforcement funding.
q: Because of Brexit, the KCB must expand its inspection capacity for checks on vegetables, fruit and ornamental plants.
Vanwege de Brexit moet het KCB de inspectiecapaciteit uitbreiden voor controles van groente/fruit/sierteelt.

36250-XVI.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, along with the agency and budget fund statements. It also adjusts spending lines such as moving €45 million of corona job subsidy budget to 2023 due to fraud found in an earlier scheme.
36250-XVI.j: The memorandum justifies the €45 million shift to 2023 as a technical adjustment made necessary by fraud detected in the earlier COZO scheme.
q: The largest part of the €41.5 million change is a technical change, namely the transfer of €45 million of budget for the Corona jobs in healthcare subsidy scheme to 2023.
Het grootste deel van de mutatie van € 41,5 miljoen betreft een technische mutatie, namelijk de overheveling van budget voor de subsidieregeling Coronabanen in de zorg van € 45 miljoen naar 2023.

36470-XIII.s: This second supplementary budget amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate and the budgets of its executive agencies, lowering total expenditure authorisations and cash expenditure in several policy articles. The main changes reduce Nationaal Groeifonds funds, Klimaatfonds and SDE funds, Groningen earthquake-damage spending, and corona scheme budgets, with a transfer of 23.56 million euro into the Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland budget.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and of the budget statement on the agencies of this ministry, all for the year 2023.

Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2023.

36534-(R2193).s: The bill approves, for the entire Kingdom of the Netherlands, the 2022 amendments to the International Health Regulations (2005) adopted in Geneva, as required under Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad and does not itself delegate powers or change oversight arrangements.
36534-(R2193).j: The memorandum states the government considers the amendments do not contain provisions binding on individuals under Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution, so no new powers are claimed.
q: In the government's view, the amendments contain no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
Naar het oordeel van de regering bevatten de wijzigingen geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet

parties: Questions whether a ten-month period is too short for a government, possibly caretaker, to make a reservation or reject an amendment, and asks about implementation feasibility.
The PVV members consider a response period of ten months very short for making a reservation or rejecting a proposal.
De leden van de PVV-fractie achten een reactietermijn van tien maanden erg kort om een voorbehoud te maken of een voorstel te verwerpen.
Asks whether the government can guarantee that the shortened response time does not reduce the quality of objections or amendments.
Can the government guarantee that this shortened response time will not lead to a qualitative decline in objections or amendments?
Kan de regering garanderen dat deze ingekorte reactietijd niet tot kwalitatieve achteruitgang van bezwaren dan wel wijzigingen leidt?
Asks about the international balance of forces around the bill and the consequences for the Dutch approval process.
The VVD members ask whether the government can indicate the international balance of forces surrounding this bill.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering aan kan geven wat het internationale krachtenveld is rondom onderhavig wetsvoorstel.
Asks how the amendment strengthens pandemic preparedness and how it relates to the Wpg tranches.
In what way will the proposed amendment strengthen pandemic preparedness, ask these members of the government.
Op welke wijze zal de voorliggende wijziging de pandemische paraatheid versterken, zo vragen deze leden de regering.
Opposes the shorter deadlines and argues they may undermine a careful process for member states to review amendments and adjust national law.
The BBB members are finally opposed to shortening the periods for objecting and for amendments to enter into force.
De leden van de BBB-fractie zijn tot slot tegen het verkorten van de termijnen van het maken van bezwaar en in werking treden van wijzigingen.
Asks whether the shortened reservation period affects parliamentary democratic control and whether the explicit approval procedure remains intact.
Does the explicit approval procedure for these amendments remain in place, and what happens if parliamentary treatment is not finished within those ten months?
Blijft de expliciete goedkeuringsprocedure van deze wijzigingen wel in stand en wat gebeurt er als de parlementaire behandeling daarvan nog niet is afgerond binnen die tien maanden?
Asks for justification of the ten-month and twelve-month periods and whether a reservation has lasting suspensive effect until a parliamentary decision.
They ask the government to clarify whether, if the Netherlands enters a reservation within ten months, it remains in effect until a final decision by the Dutch parliament.

Zij vragen de regering om toe te lichten of het zo is dat als Nederland binnen tien maanden een voorbehoud plaatst, dit voorbehoud geldt totdat er een definitief besluit is genomen door het Nederlandse parlement.
Asks whether ten months is sufficient for reservations and how much time the Tweede Kamer will actually have to object.
Additionally, these members would like to know what the response time of the Tweede Kamer becomes under the new ten-month period.
Daarnaast zouden genoemde leden graag nog willen weten wat, bij de nieuwe termijn van tien maanden, de reactietijd van de Tweede Kamer wordt?
Asks whether Curaçao's autonomy over health measures is limited and whether sufficient safeguards prevent the WHO from gaining too much power over national health policy.
Are there sufficient safeguards built in to prevent the World Health Organization (WHO) from gaining too much power over national health policy?
Zijn er voldoende waarborgen ingebouwd om te voorkomen dat de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO) te veel macht krijgt over het nationale gezondheidsbeleid?
Asks how the government views implementation of the shortened reservation period and what this means for the Land Curaçao, noting limited national capacity to respond.
How does the government view developments in implementing this regulation with regard to the shortened period and the possibility of rejection or reservation?
Hoe ziet de regering de ontwikkelingen bij de implementatie van deze regeling met betrekking tot de termijnverkorting en de mogelijkheid van verwerping of voorbehoud?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft rijkswet approving the 2022 amendments to the International Health Regulations (2005) and raised no substantive remarks, recommending submission to parliament. The government's reply (nader rapport) was not included in the text beyond the advice itself, which is reproduced in full.

36560-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate and of its agencies, as a final budget adjustment (Slotwet). It sets out revised figures for obligations, expenditure and receipts per policy article and per agency, with the amounts stated in thousands of euros.
q: The obligations for the Fixed Costs Allowance (TVL) are EUR 8 million higher than estimated.
De verplichtingen voor de Tegemoetkoming Vaste Lasten (TVL) zijn € 8 mln hoger dan was geraamd.

36625-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the 2024 budget of agency DUO, via a second supplementary budget. It changes appropriations, expenditure and receipts and makes the amendments effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 29 November 2024.
q: We have approved and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2024 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd

36725-XX.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Asylum and Migration and the budget of its agency, the Immigration and Naturalisation Service (IND), in thousands of euros. It is a budget appropriation law with retroactive effect to 1 June 2025.
q: Whereas We have considered that a change to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Asylum and Migration has proven necessary.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Asiel en Migratie

36740-XIII.s: This is a Slotwet (final budget adjustment act) for 2024 that amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate and the budget for its agencies, recording actual realisations against the adopted and supplementary budgets. It delegates no rule-making power and shifts no power between the executive and checks; the explanatory extract only explains budget underspends.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2024 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd

36850-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget statements of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (Tabel 1) and of the agency DUO (Tabellen 2 and 3) through a second supplementary budget, with effect from the day after publication and retroactive to 28 November 2025. The explanatory memorandum explains the adjustments to vocational education funding, mainly savings and underspends on subsidies and receipts.
36850-VIII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to underspends and realisation figures, not by any delegation or new power.
q: This is explained by fewer training routes having been applied for within the vocational training track.
Dit wordt verklaard doordat er minder opleidingsroutes zijn aangevraagd binnen de beroepsopleidingskolom.
